sections.heading: Getting started
paragraphs: Khaled and a friend arrived at a restaurant for dinner. They talked to the staff and practised polite requests. Khaled said, “Do we need a reservation?” His friend replied, “I booked a table for two.” Khaled said, “The reservation is under Khaled.” His friend replied, “Could we sit somewhere quiet?” Khaled said, “Here is your table.” His friend replied, “May we have the menus, please?” Khaled said, “What is the special today?” His friend replied, “I would like grilled chicken.” Khaled said, “Could I get a salad on the side?” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: A useful exchange
paragraphs: As they continued, they learned to explain what they needed. Khaled said, “Please leave out the sauce.” His friend replied, “Does this meal contain nuts?” Khaled said, “I need to avoid that ingredient.” His friend replied, “Can you recommend a lighter option?” Khaled said, “I will take the vegetable soup.” His friend replied, “How long will the food take?” Khaled said, “It should be ready shortly.” His friend replied, “Could we have some water first?” Khaled said, “Everything looks wonderful.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: Making it clearer
paragraphs: They listened, asked questions, and tried the next useful expressions. Khaled said, “Enjoy your meal.” His friend replied, “The chicken is cooked perfectly.” Khaled said, “Could I have another napkin?” His friend replied, “Excuse me, this is not my order.” Khaled said, “I ordered the grilled fish.” His friend replied, “I am sorry about the mistake.” Khaled said, “We will fix it right away.” His friend replied, “Thank you for your help.” Khaled said, “Would you like some dessert?” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: Ending well
paragraphs: Before leaving, they finished the conversation warmly. Khaled said, “No dessert for me, thank you.” His friend replied, “I am ready for the bill.” Khaled said, “Can I pay at the counter?” His friend replied, “Could I have a receipt?” Khaled said, “The service was very good.” His friend replied, “We enjoyed our dinner.” Khaled said, “Have a lovely evening.” They felt more confident after practising together.
